If the actual singer were the Love cutout, I’d expect the name to be more stable across independent recollections. The Limozeen angle also feels more native to Homestar Runner: they’re the established fictional band whose images and performances recur, so a cardboard cutout of Larry Palaroncini as a budget prom act fits the show’s usual joke furniture. Peacey P and Brett Bretterson seem like one-off guesses from the wider character pool without the same convergence. Unless someone can cite a concrete line or visual detail that pins the prom cutout specifically to the Love singer, I’d stick with Larry Palaroncini.
